source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 24 May 1952, p. 6 ("Four contests in Fermanagh local government elections")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Enniskillen rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. There were no contests and three changes of personnel. No nomination was received for Doagh, whose sitting member was automatically re-elected. The Fermanagh Herald prints the nominations. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Corryglass' to Corraglass (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Corraglass; the rounds were filed as Corryglass (1924, 1927, 1936, 1952); Corraglass (1930, 1933, 1939, 1946, 1961, 1964); Conyglass (1949); Corrygloss (1955, 1958). This round was filed as 'Corryglass', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (corryglass) answers with a redirect to this one.
